notes.title: Update Base AI Model
notes.content: [p]I've updated the base AI model, which has nearly doubled the processing speed and reduced VRAM usage. [/p][p]In exchange, there has been a slight decrease in accuracy, but we plan to continue fine-tuning this.[/p]

notes.title: Add Shapes Control and Translation Update
notes.content: [p]I have updated the demo version as below;[/p][p][/p][h3]Add Shapes Control in Main Game Scene[/h3][list][*][p]You can command about shapes for some operations, such as "Cut out", "Cut at angle" and so on.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Translation Update[/h3][list][*][p]Translation is updated. In particular, the translation of narrative text has been updated to sound more natural.[/p][/*][/list]
